entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Future leader in training?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Future leader in training?”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Ha! You could say that. After elev..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ha! You could say that. After eleven daughters, courtesy of my eight wives -- all of whom I’m still married to -- I finally have a boy! Meet Wiktor Smolak II.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“We're having a father-son weekend...."
entries.dialogueText: “We're having a father-son weekend."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Impressive airship you have here,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Impressive airship you have here, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“It's my pride and joy, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's my pride and joy, Your Majesty. Won it in a bet with Chancellor Hegel of Valgsland, though he won’t admit to it if you ask.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was then that I felt the airship..."
entries.dialogueText: It was then that I felt the airship begin its ascent. I looked out the window as the sprawling capital city beneath us became smaller and smaller.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“I hope you had a good rest, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope you had a good rest, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I’d take a whiskey, actually.""
entries.dialogueText: “I’d take a whiskey, actually."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We took our seats in front of the w..."
entries.dialogueText: We took our seats in front of the window with a view just as fantastic as before.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“To traveling in style! Cheers!”"
entries.dialogueText: “To traveling in style! Cheers!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak and I clinked glasses."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak and I clinked glasses.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before taking a drink, I reached ov..."
entries.dialogueText: Before taking a drink, I reached over and tapped my glass to the baby’s milk bottle, eliciting a roaring laugh from Smolak.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Very good, Your Majesty! It’s refr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very good, Your Majesty! It’s refreshing to see a world leader who doesn't take himself seriously."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“I could invite Prime Minister Alva..."
entries.dialogueText: “I could invite Prime Minister Alvarez here, but he'd pay more attention to the liquor than the view."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“And Queen Beatrice? Ha! Forget abo..."
entries.dialogueText: “And Queen Beatrice? Ha! Forget about it."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It’s as if they don’t want to be f..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s as if they don’t want to be friends -- not like us.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do friends go over to each other's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do friends go over to each other's homes, only to become permanent residents, rearranging furniture, dictating house rules, and never leaving?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that what we are? Friends?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that what we are? Friends?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just a water, if you will.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just a water, if you will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope to have a son of my own som..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope to have a son of my own someday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How heartwarming. Let's talk about..."
entries.dialogueText: "How heartwarming. Let's talk about Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Interesting. I never took you for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting. I never took you for a family man."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Looks like even presidents have to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like even presidents have to multitask these days."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And who is this little mister?""
entries.dialogueText: "And who is this little mister?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I suppose that depends on how you..."
entries.dialogueText: “I suppose that depends on how you define friendship.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Funny you should mention it…”"
entries.dialogueText: “Funny you should mention it…”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“We signed an agreement regarding t..."
entries.dialogueText: “We signed an agreement regarding that very subject.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I seem to remember it being much l..."
entries.dialogueText: “I seem to remember it being much longer. Dozens of pages longer, in fact."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Let me fill you in on a little sec..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let me fill you in on a little secret… you know, being friends and all...”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“I don’t read any of the bills or t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don’t read any of the bills or treaties that I put my name on. I have a whole department whose job it is to handle that.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“I preferred the annotated version...."
entries.dialogueText: “I preferred the annotated version. Direct and to the point.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Then allow me to be direct and to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Then allow me to be direct and to the point. I'm here to ensure the removal of Wehlen forces from the territory of Zille. I hope this effort hasn't been in vain."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“I’ll be the judge of that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I’ll be the judge of that.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Well, what are we waiting for? Let..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well, what are we waiting for? Let's get to it!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“We made an agreement, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: “We made an agreement, Your Majesty. I believe we both remember its terms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Indeed. We made a trade deal.""
entries.dialogueText: “Indeed. We made a trade deal."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Yes, we did.""
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, we did."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak sipped his drink before pull..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak sipped his drink before pulling out a cocktail napkin from his jacket pocket. There was vague scribblings on it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He held up the napkin, where I coul..."
entries.dialogueText: He held up the napkin, where I could make out a list of the terms to our amended treaty.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He waved his napkin around once mor..."
entries.dialogueText: He waved his napkin around once more.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak’s expression turned cold."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak’s expression turned cold.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A brief moment of tension quickly s..."
entries.dialogueText: A brief moment of tension quickly subsided with a flash of the president's trademark smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His attention returned to his napki..."
entries.dialogueText: His attention returned to his napkin.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please tell me we're not determini..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please tell me we're not determining the fate of millions via a cocktail napkin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How could I forget?""
entries.dialogueText: "How could I forget?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I honestly couldn't care less. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "I honestly couldn't care less. You owe me a conversation about Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can we please get back on track? I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can we please get back on track? I fear we're moving in the wrong direction."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I do. There was a security co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I do. There was a security component."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd prefer that we skip over this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd prefer that we skip over this charade and get to where you tell me you'll hand Zille back to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Don't rush me, Your Majesty. You o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't rush me, Your Majesty. You of all people should know about decorum and etiquette."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll leave it to the host's discre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll leave it to the host's discretion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. Then let's discuss trad..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Then let's discuss trade."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, if that's the way you wish t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if that's the way you wish to proceed, then let's discuss security-related matters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I assure you, Mr. President, I am..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you, Mr. President, I am well versed in such matters and don't need a lecturing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need lectures on decorum a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need lectures on decorum and etiquette, especially from you. You forget who you're speaking to."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Let's take a step back and pretend..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's take a step back and pretend the last thirty seconds never happened."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Let's not start negotiations off o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not start negotiations off on the wrong foot, shall we? We've only just begun."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But for the sake of time, I'll kic..."
entries.dialogueText: "But for the sake of time, I'll kick things off with the issue of trade."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Pending your objection, I'll go ah..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pending your objection, I'll go ahead and get to the issue of Wehlen-Rizian trade."

entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, Wehlen can count on steadfast allies like Sordland, who acknowledge the danger posed by the BFF."

entries.dialogueText: "While our operations are still ongoing, I have all the confidence that we will succeed."

entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's stance on this matter is clear. I don't feel the necessity to repeat myself."

entries.dialogueText: "Careful with absolutes. You may find yourself boxed in by your own convictions."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Maybe not now, but, nevertheless,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe not now, but, nevertheless, I suggest keeping an open mind."

entries.dialogueText: "You sure have it out for the Bluds, Mr. President."

entries.dialogueText: "On the contrary, my focus is solely on safeguarding the security and prosperity of our nation."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""My focus is solely on safeguarding..."
entries.dialogueText: "My focus is solely on safeguarding the security and prosperity of our nation."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The actions against the Bluds are..."
entries.dialogueText: "The actions against the Bluds are necessary measures to ensure Wehlen's stability."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am pleased to hear it, but we mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am pleased to hear it, but we must remain cautious. Crushing a movement is one thing, but killing an idea is another."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Naturally, our leadership and prow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Naturally, our leadership and prowess were the driving forces behind the crushing defeat, with Sordland merely tagging along."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed, our combined efforts have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, our combined efforts have brought about a resounding victory!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Which is why Wehlen intends to foc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why Wehlen intends to focus on ensuring that the ideology fueling their cause dies alongside the BFF."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, let us hope Sordland doesn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, let us hope Sordland doesn't have spies among us to overhear your little insult."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Though, just between us, Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though, just between us, Sordland overestimates its importance in such matters."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Yes, a partnership that stands to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, a partnership that stands to open up new avenues for future collaboration."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak looked at his cocktail napki..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak looked at his cocktail napkin.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's been deposed. That should sti..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's been deposed. That should still serve the same purpose."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I removed him from his leadership..."
entries.dialogueText: "I removed him from his leadership position in Iza. Given the circumstances, please know that was the extent of my ability to act."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because the more I deliberated on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because the more I deliberated on it, the more I realized that the political fallout from arresting my cousin would be too great. It's as simple as that."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Not only that.... he's marrying th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only that.... he's marrying the Crown Princess! You royals and your strange traditions..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Needless to say, it was quite dist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Needless to say, it was quite distressing to hear that particular piece of news."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Yes, well apparently, Wehlen doesn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, well apparently, Wehlen doesn't fall under what you consider 'political fallout.'"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Invoking 'inability to act' is a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Invoking 'inability to act' is a sign of weakness. I do hope that moving forward, you'll find more *effective* ways to address such challenges."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Don't confuse punishment with just..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't confuse punishment with justice. They aren't interchangeable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As he should be. He might be flawe..."
entries.dialogueText: "As he should be. He might be flawed, but incarcerating him won't make your problems go away."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. And?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. And?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Then you fail to see the impact of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you fail to see the impact of what one individual can do."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And that won't benefit you in any..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that won't benefit you in any way, regarding Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It gave me no pleasure to do so, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "It gave me no pleasure to do so, but I'm a man of my word."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hopefully, his time will be well-s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hopefully, his time will be well-spent contemplating the consequences of his actions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May he reflect on his misdeeds and..."
entries.dialogueText: "May he reflect on his misdeeds and seek redemption during his time of confinement."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I couldn't care less what he conte..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't care less what he contemplates. I'm just glad he's there."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And for that, you have my respect.""
entries.dialogueText: "And for that, you have my respect."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'll leave redemption to God, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll leave redemption to God, but don't expect any divine intervention to fix his mess."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. It was about time that dog..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. It was about time that dog was placed in his kennel."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Ha! Let's hope his bark is worse t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! Let's hope his bark is worse than his bite behind those bars."

entries.dialogueText: "Now, as for our agreement's other terms..."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Smolak finished his drink very slowly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me then... do we have a deal?""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me then... do we have a deal?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "So what do you say... does Rizia meet your criteria for friendship?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Any more napkins in there that I s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any more napkins in there that I should know about?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So where does this leave us?""
entries.dialogueText: "So where does this leave us?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak abruptly halted mid-sentence..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak abruptly halted mid-sentence, seemingly captivated by the view outside the window. He stood up and approached the glass.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.dialogueText: "Leave us? Well, the way I see it--"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, as far as friendship goes--""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, as far as friendship goes--"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, the way I see it...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, the way I see it..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now that you mention it--""
entries.dialogueText: "Now that you mention it--"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your Majesty... may I present, Zil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... may I present, Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Turning to see what had caught his..."
entries.dialogueText: Turning to see what had caught his attention, my gaze caught the rays of the setting sun traveling across an open body of water, illuminating an all-too-familiar city on a distant shore.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must say, you've outdone yoursel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say, you've outdone yourself this time, Smolak. The view is absolutely stunning."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You dragged me all the way out her..."
entries.dialogueText: "You dragged me all the way out here for this? If you intend to waste any more of my time, tell me now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You always were one for theatrics...."
entries.dialogueText: "You always were one for theatrics. I'm impressed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I'm well aware of what I'm lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm well aware of what I'm looking at."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, aren't you the astute one.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, aren't you the astute one."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Why thank you, Your Majesty. I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why thank you, Your Majesty. I do try to keep the drama at a royal level."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That's putting it lightly.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's putting it lightly."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""My apologies, Your Majesty. I shou..."
entries.dialogueText: "My apologies, Your Majesty. I should have known you preferred the comfort of your throne to the excitement of a spontaneous adventure."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak and I continued to gaze at t..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak and I continued to gaze at the view in silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak returned his gaze to the vie..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak returned his gaze to the view before us as a momentary silence fell between us.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.dialogueText: "I must say, the sight of Zille takes my breath away every time I see it..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I must say... the sight of Zille t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say... the sight of Zille takes my breath away every time I see it..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Which is why I will very much miss..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why I will very much miss seeing the Wehlen flag flying proudly over its expanse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're saying you're giving up con..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're saying you're giving up control over Zille?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Miss seeing Wehlen's flag fly ove..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Miss seeing Wehlen's flag fly over it?' Hold on... did you just say what I think you said?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough with the veiled words, Smol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough with the veiled words, Smolak. Speak plainly and say what you mean."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what's the catch? Surely you'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what's the catch? Surely you're not suddenly feeling sentimental about Zille?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Back up a minute. What are you say..."
entries.dialogueText: "Back up a minute. What are you saying?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm saying that you've gone above..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm saying that you've gone above and beyond in your efforts to secure Zille's return to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As far as I'm considered, Zille is..."
entries.dialogueText: "As far as I'm considered, Zille is yours."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And you have my most sincere respe..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you have my most sincere respect and deepest admiration."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""However, I do have *one* more smal..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I do have *one* more small request of you..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I knew it."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""What Wehlen and Rizia have goes be..."
entries.dialogueText: "What Wehlen and Rizia have goes beyond friendship... it's a bond that cannot be broken."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We spent the remainder of our weeke..."
entries.dialogueText: We spent the remainder of our weekend traversing the skies aboard Smolak's airship, immersing ourselves in Wehlen's stunning vistas.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Amidst sipping on fine wine and rev..."
entries.dialogueText: Amidst sipping on fine wine and reveling in each other's company, the significance of our successful diplomatic negotiations for Zille's return gradually became apparent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "However, it wasn't until after our..."
entries.dialogueText: However, it wasn't until after our descent, during my journey back to the palace, that the full weight of it all truly struck me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Amidst exchanging stories and revel..."
entries.dialogueText: Amidst exchanging stories and reveling in each other's company, the weight of our successful diplomatic negotiations for Zille's return gradually became apparent.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, go on. Let's hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, go on. Let's hear it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Tell me what you want. I'm sure we can address the issue."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, but you've reached your lim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, but you've reached your limit for additional requests from Rizia. I won't consider anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, that is such bullshit! After e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, that is such bullshit! After everything I've done to meet your 'conditions,' you honestly expect me to comply with yet another demand?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It goes without saying that I've b..."
entries.dialogueText: "It goes without saying that I've become quite fond of Zille. The last thing I'd ever want is to never step foot there again."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I understand your frustration, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your frustration, but please bear with me as I explain the necessity of this additional step."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That's why, as a final gesture of..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's why, as a final gesture of goodwill and to solidify our agreement, I request ownership of your mother's childhood home."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It would not only serve as a symbo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would not only serve as a symbol of our mutual trust, but commitment to the future of our nations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That house holds great sentimental..."
entries.dialogueText: "That house holds great sentimental value to both my mother and myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't know what game you're play..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what game you're playing, but erase that notion from your head this instant!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Sorry. But I just have to have it...."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. But I just have to have it. If not, well, I'm not sure I can give you what you ultimately desire."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you out of your mind? Of cours..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you out of your mind? Of course, I won't agree to such an arrangement."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But given everything we've just di..."
entries.dialogueText: "But given everything we've just discussed, I'm afraid I simply can't part with it. It holds too much... sentimental value."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm honestly shocked to hear this...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm honestly shocked to hear this. Is there anything Rizia can do to change your mind?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, please... Stop beating around..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, please... Stop beating around the bush and tell me what you want."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you brought me all the way out..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you brought me all the way out here just to tell me no?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""There's no need to shout, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no need to shout, Your Majesty. You seem to forget the first rule of diplomacy..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Lord shall not forgive you for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord shall not forgive you for this, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now, now, Your Majesty... there's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, now, Your Majesty... there's no need to bring the Lord into this just yet."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""There's always room for negotiatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's always room for negotiation."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Come now, Your Majesty. You seem t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now, Your Majesty. You seem to forget the first rule of diplomacy..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now we're talking, Your Majesty! I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now we're talking, Your Majesty! It's heartening to see that you recognize the value of mutual concessions. After all..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""What I want is for you to take a b..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I want is for you to take a breath, and read between the lines of what I'm trying to imply. That being..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak reached into his pants pocke..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak reached into his pants pocket and retrieved another cocktail napkin with writing on it. He held it out.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""See? I always come prepared.""
entries.dialogueText: "See? I always come prepared."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. Give it here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Give it here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So it seems.""
entries.dialogueText: "So it seems."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You had better be prepared to deal..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had better be prepared to deal with the consequences should these negotiations fail."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: I seized the napkin and read over his conditions.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: I took the napkin and read over his conditions.

entries.dialogueText: I took the napkin and read over his conditions.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do hope you're just as prepared..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope you're just as prepared for the potential ramifications should these negotiations not reach a satisfactory conclusion."

entries.dialogueText: "But in all seriousness, I'm pleased to hear it. There's nothing more justifiably moral than defending one's land, and the people you love."

entries.dialogueText: "No. I'm not going to let you kill people with our weapons. I don't want that kind of blood on my hands."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That's unfortunate to hear. Noneth..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's unfortunate to hear. Nonetheless, if you're adamant about your position, perhaps we could explore an alternative solution?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't have resources to provide..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't have resources to provide you with what you're asking. I suggest you find gold somewhere else."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm sorry to hear that. However, i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry to hear that. However, if you're firm in your stance, maybe we can explore another option?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""A nation with one of the highest c..."
entries.dialogueText: "A nation with one of the highest concentration of gold deposits on the continent, and you can't spare just a fraction of your wealth?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Think of it as a friendly suggesti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think of it as a friendly suggestion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright. You want to negotiate? I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. You want to negotiate? I'll negotiate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then my answer is no. What you've..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then my answer is no. What you've asked of me will only hurt Rizia in the long run."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""President Smolak, Rizia will not e..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak, Rizia will not entertain any proposition that compromises our sovereignty. As far as I'm concerned, negotiations end here."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Wait, wait, wait... you're telling..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait, wait, wait... you're telling me, that after everything we've been through, all the back and forth over Zille, you're just going to give up?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head in mock disappoin..."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head in mock disappointment.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It's a shame, really...""
entries.dialogueText: "It's a shame, really..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But if you're not willing to discu..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you're not willing to discuss further..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please... any referendum run by yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please... any referendum run by you would have an outcome decided ahead of time."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'll take that as a no. But you se..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll take that as a no. But you see, Your Majesty, this decision is not entirely in your hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Okay, I'll bite. Tell me more abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, I'll bite. Tell me more about this referendum."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Are you absolutely sure you want i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you absolutely sure you want it to come to that, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed to the cocktail napkin,..."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed to the cocktail napkin, which I'd forgotten was still in my hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, back to that again? My answer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, back to that again? My answer is still no."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. I'll negotiate. However, I d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I'll negotiate. However, I don't want any surprise requests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, this?""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I tore the napkin in half, letting..."
entries.dialogueText: I tore the napkin in half, letting it float to the floor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I wadded up the napkin and threw it..."
entries.dialogueText: I wadded up the napkin and threw it on the floor.
entries.menuText: Wad up and throw on floor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I handed the napkin back to Smolak."
entries.dialogueText: I handed the napkin back to Smolak.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Something to remember me by when y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Something to remember me by when you realize you made the biggest mistake of your life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's best if you keep it.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's best if you keep it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Be sure to toss it in the trash on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be sure to toss it in the trash on your way out."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak didn't so much as flinch."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak didn't so much as flinch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak showed no reaction."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak showed no reaction.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, I'm not.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, I'm not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright. You want to negotiate? I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. You want to negotiate? I'll negotiate."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A quiet moment settled between us...."
entries.dialogueText: A quiet moment settled between us. Smolak, once more, directed his gaze towards our vantage point of Zille. He appeared unusually solemn.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I said it once, but I'll say it ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "I said it once, but I'll say it again... the sight of Zille will always take my breath away..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Which is why I will very much miss..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why I will very much miss seeing the Wehlen flag flying proudly over it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "By this time, the sun had completel..."
entries.dialogueText: By this time, the sun had completely disappeared beyond the horizon, and the lights of the harbor city were coming to life.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I just wanted to say how pleased I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just wanted to say how pleased I am by your resilience and willingness to find common ground."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As I previously mentioned, I'm mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I previously mentioned, I'm more than willing to hold a referendum regarding Zille's status to Wehlen and Rizia if certain criteria were met."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And I'm happy to say that they wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I'm happy to say that they were."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean a referendum? I t..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean a referendum? I thought we had a deal."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We do have a deal. But by the look..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do have a deal. But by the look on your face, I'm guessing it wasn't what you were expecting."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me more about this referendum..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me more about this referendum you keep referring to."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Gladly. You see...""
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly. You see..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What game are you playing at? This..."
entries.dialogueText: "What game are you playing at? This is starting to sound like another last-minute condition."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Not at all. You see, I believe Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all. You see, I believe Rizia should have the same chances of having Zille return to you as does Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why do I get the feeling the ball..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why do I get the feeling the ball is about to drop?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now, now... you're looking at this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, now... you're looking at this situation all wrong. You're getting the chance to reunify with Zille -- the same chance Wehlen is getting."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, I've played along with y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, I've played along with you enough. I refuse to make any more concessions."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm not thrilled about you wasting..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not thrilled about you wasting my time, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He started to leave before turning..."
entries.dialogueText: He started to leave before turning back.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now, if you'll excuse me, I need t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to tend to little Wiktor."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Oh well, I'll have plenty of time..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh well, I'll have plenty of time to come to terms with it at my Villa in Zill-a. See what I did there?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you really have no intention of..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you really have no intention of fulfilling the terms of our agreement."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Agreement? What agreement...""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreement? What agreement..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your wit is as sharp as a spoon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your wit is as sharp as a spoon."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, I don't wish to see you spoo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I don't wish to see you spooner than later, but let's hope your wit can at least fork out something better next time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You truly live up to everything ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "You truly live up to everything everyone says about you, and then some."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I always aim to exceed expectation..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always aim to exceed expectations."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Actually, on second thought...""
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, on second thought..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You see, over these last few years..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see, over these last few years I've I've become quite fond of Zille. And believe me, I was just as surprised as you might be to hear it."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""With that in mind, the last thing..."
entries.dialogueText: "With that in mind, the last thing I'd ever want is to never set foot there again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd say you were bluffing, but I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd say you were bluffing, but I honestly believe you might be a walking, talking piece of shit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If that's all that stands in the w..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's all that stands in the way of our long-awaited reunification with Zille... then I accept. Consider the house yours."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Ha! That wasn't the answer I was l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! That wasn't the answer I was looking for, but it's the answer I'll accept. Forget about the request. Let's celebrate to new beginning!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Really? I'm honestly surprised you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? I'm honestly surprised you'd agree to such terms."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Come, we have much to celebrate!""
entries.dialogueText: "Come, we have much to celebrate!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak shook his head.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Oh, King Romus... I'm afraid that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, King Romus... I'm afraid that was the wrong answer."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As a result, in lieu of simply han..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a result, in lieu of simply handing the keys to Zille over to you, I believe it would be best to hold a referendum on the transfer issue instead."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I must say... the sight of Zille t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say... the sight of Zille takes my breath away every time I see it... As I hope it does for you too."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Get a good look, Your Majesty, bec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get a good look, Your Majesty, because, I'm sorry to say, you won't get many opportunities to do so in the future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You mean you're not giving it back..."
entries.dialogueText: "You mean you're not giving it back? Like hell, you won't!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Please keep your voice down, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please keep your voice down, Your Majesty. Little Wiky is asleep in the other room."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm going to treasure this moment...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to treasure this moment. After all, it's not every day I witness someone digging their own grave."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I wish I could help you. I really..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could help you. I really do. But a deal's a deal. I have a reputation to uphold."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If I stop following through with m..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I stop following through with my threats -- sorry, promises -- no one will take me seriously."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes sparkled with suppressed l..."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes sparkled with suppressed laughter.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I beg your pardon, Mr. President?..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg your pardon, Mr. President? Are you saying you plan to extend the Threat Mitigation Protocol indefinitely?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""From here on out...""
entries.dialogueText: "From here on out..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taken aback, I paused for a moment..."
entries.dialogueText: Taken aback, I paused for a moment to process what I'd just heard.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Come now, Your Majesty. Empty thre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now, Your Majesty. Empty threats are beneath someone of your stature."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Believe me, there was nothing empt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, there was nothing empty about them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Empty threats? You underestimate m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Empty threats? You underestimate me, Smolak."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That's cute.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's cute."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The only one here beneath my statu..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only one here beneath my stature is you."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Whatever you say, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm saying that I'm not yet fully..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm saying that I'm not yet fully confident in your kingdom's ability to govern this province I have come to know and love."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My eyes remained locked on an enorm..."
entries.dialogueText: My eyes remained locked on an enormous airship moored at a blimp base on the outskirts of the Presidential Palace in Wraclawitz, Wehlen's capital. Its sleek form dominated the skyline.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Standing before it, I absorbed the..."
entries.dialogueText: Standing before it, I absorbed the sight of President Smolak's imposing image prominently displayed on its side, alongside the flag of Wehlen and bold proclamations of Wehlen's rise to prominence:

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "“With Smolak at the Helm: Wehlen So..."
entries.dialogueText: “With Smolak at the Helm: Wehlen Soars to New Heights!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our agreement's three-year probatio..."
entries.dialogueText: Our agreement's three-year probationary period had come to an end. It was finally time to discuss the return of Zille. However, my host was nowhere in sight.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Flanked by Golden Guardsmen, I even..."
entries.dialogueText: Flanked by Golden Guardsmen, I eventually made my way up the red carpet stretching from my motorcade to the airship's gondola, past a dozen or so young women in impeccably pressed uniforms.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The interior of the ship was adorne..."
entries.dialogueText: The interior of the ship was adorned with lavish blue and white drapes cascading from floor-to-ceiling windows.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Crystal chandeliers hung from the c..."
entries.dialogueText: Crystal chandeliers hung from the ceiling, casting a dazzling array of light across the space.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gondola cabin practically screa..."
entries.dialogueText: The gondola cabin practically screamed excess, to the point of absurdity.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And there, standing amongst it all,..."
entries.dialogueText: And there, standing amongst it all, was the man of the hour, Wiktor Smolak.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Welcome aboard, Your Majesty! So g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Welcome aboard, Your Majesty! So glad you could join me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was then I noticed that he was c..."
entries.dialogueText: It was then I noticed that he was carrying a baby who couldn't have been more than a year old.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Ha! You don't know the half of it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! You don't know the half of it."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This would be my son, Wiktor Smola..."
entries.dialogueText: "This would be my son, Wiktor Smolak II. After eleven daughters, courtesy of my eight wives -- all of whom I’m still married to -- I finally have a boy!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It's never too late, Your Majesty!..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's never too late, Your Majesty! Not for men like us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, shall we get to it then?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, shall we get to it then?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Looks like that's our cue to get t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like that's our cue to get this meeting started."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whenever you're ready, I'm more th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whenever you're ready, I'm more than happy to begin our discussion."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""On the contrary, I'd say this is t..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the contrary, I'd say this is the perfect time to sightsee."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""By all means, relax and enjoy your..."
entries.dialogueText: "By all means, relax and enjoy yourself. I'll be back later once I spend some quality time with the kid."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""What's the rush? We've got plenty..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the rush? We've got plenty of time to talk. We've got a long flight ahead of us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several hours later, I woke up to t..."
entries.dialogueText: Several hours later, I woke up to the site of a vast expanse of ocean appearing over the horizon. I had fallen asleep in one of the lounge chairs on the observation deck.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to see Smolak standing ove..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to see Smolak standing over me. Little Wiktor was in his arms.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A coffee, please.""
entries.dialogueText: "A coffee, please."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks, but I'm good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks, but I'm good."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You wish to get straight to the po..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wish to get straight to the point. Come with me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We made our way to a private room w..."
entries.dialogueText: We made our way to a private room where drinks were already set out for us. Even the baby had a bottle waiting for him.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Right away. Come with me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away. Come with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A wine sounds nice.""
entries.dialogueText: "A wine sounds nice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever you're having.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you're having."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""His Majesty shall receive all the..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty shall receive all the hydration he desires. Come with me."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Great choice. We shall drink and c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great choice. We shall drink and converse like men."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You do love wine in your country,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You do love wine in your country, don't you? Right this way."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I confess I'm not much of a drinke..."
entries.dialogueText: "I confess I'm not much of a drinker, Your Majesty. Unless it's to butter up a potential trade partner. Shall we?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Patience is a virtue, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "Patience is a virtue, Your Majesty. We haven't even taken off yet."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I get that a lot.""
entries.dialogueText: "I get that a lot."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Hey, take a step back. Relax and e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, take a step back. Relax and enjoy the ride! We've got a long flight ahead of us."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You're the first world leader to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the first world leader to share a ride on my airship."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm honored.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm honored."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because I'm the only one who didn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because I'm the only one who didn't turn down your invitation?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Actually, yes. Nobody wants go any..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, yes. Nobody wants go anywhere outside their council room walls. Everyone's so official and by the book."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You should be. Everyone else is so..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should be. Everyone else is so official and by the book."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why am I not surprised?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why am I not surprised?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""What can I say, I have a way with..."
entries.dialogueText: "What can I say, I have a way with people. Though, there are a rare few who don't seem to enjoy my company."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Our two nations have been there fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our two nations have been there for each other in the past. I see no reason why we can't continue that partnership now and in the years to come."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Ah, I see what you did there. Some..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, I see what you did there. Someone wants to get right to talking about Zille."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Very well. Let's get right to it t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Let's get right to it then."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Which is why we're here, so let's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why we're here, so let's get into it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak sipped his drink before pull..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak sipped his drink before pulling out a cocktail napkin from his jacket pocket. There was vague scribblings on it.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If you remember, we signed an agre..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you remember, we signed an agreement regarding the conditions for Zille's return to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Oh, I never remember anything I si..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I never remember anything I sign. In fact, I'm going to fill you in on a little secret..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I beg your pardon. I'll try to use..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg your pardon. I'll try to use a chalkboard next time."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As you can see, I made a few notes..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you can see, I made a few notes ahead of time. Though, it's a bit hard to read. Helps me be direct and to the point."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, I for one define a friend as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I for one define a friend as someone you can trust to be completely honest with you."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“So, where would you like to begin?..."
entries.dialogueText: “So, where would you like to begin? Trade deals? Security pacts?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If that's the case, we can just sk..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's the case, we can just skip ahead and get to the heart of the matter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up a nearby telephone and..."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up a nearby telephone and spoke into it. Before long, a woman came in and took baby Wiktor away.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I think we can make this brief.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think we can make this brief."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I left questioning whether or not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I left questioning whether or not Rizia could be trusted to uphold agreements or negotiate in good faith in general."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I assure you, we can.""
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you, we can."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That has yet to be determined.""
entries.dialogueText: "That has yet to be determined."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We do respect you. I'm here, aren'..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do respect you. I'm here, aren't I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Words word words. That's all I'm h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Words word words. That's all I'm hearing. Just get to the point and tell me if you'll uphold the treaty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It all depends.""
entries.dialogueText: "It all depends."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Just because you're here doesn't m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just because you're here doesn't make you a trusted ally. Those sorts of relationships take time."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The sight of Zille takes my breath..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sight of Zille takes my breath away every time I see it..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But given everything we've just di..."
entries.dialogueText: "But given everything we've just discussed, I'm afraid I simply can't hand it over to you."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""However, I'll tell you what I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I'll tell you what I will do. Because I'm a nice guy, I'm willing to let the people of Zille decide their leadership for themselves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak shot me a dirty look."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak shot me a dirty look.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Yes, it would seem so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it would seem so."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You also promised to provide us wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You also promised to provide us with military equipment. However, we're getting hardly any at all. I hear your stockpiles are running low?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That's not good for either of us,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not good for either of us, is it?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You also promised to provide us wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You also promised to provide us with military equipment, which you've followed through on."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Given all of our ongoing conflicts..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given all of our ongoing conflicts... the more guns, the better."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several hours later, after falling..."
entries.dialogueText: Several hours later, after falling asleep on one of the lounge chairs on the observation deck, I was startled awake by the sharp slap of a newspaper hitting the side table beside me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a copy of the Royal Herald,..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a copy of the Royal Herald, the top story being the revelation about Lespia’s involvement in the Friendship Day bombing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak was standing over me with a..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak was standing over me with a grin on his face. Little Wiktor was in his arms.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""So this really is true then, eh, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "So this really is true then, eh, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course. I wouldn’t have ordered..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I wouldn’t have ordered its publication, otherwise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Every word of it. We have the evid..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every word of it. We have the evidence to prove its authenticity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If it's in the paper, then it must..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's in the paper, then it must be true."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Well, I must say… I’m both shocked..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well, I must say… I’m both shocked and impressed.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That's reassuring.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's reassuring."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Ha! Yes. A sentiment I share as we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! Yes. A sentiment I share as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't know the details yet. Ric..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't know the details yet. Ricardus may have been working in concert with Alvarez's government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are the one who wanted my cous..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are the one who wanted my cousin out of power. You didn't care whether he was innocent or not, so why should I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ricardus may not have planted the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ricardus may not have planted the bomb, but he stoked the hatred between Rizians and Wehzeks, making it easier for Lespians to exploit us."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That makes a lot of sense, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "That makes a lot of sense, Your Majesty. Perhaps not to a court, but to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed delightedly."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed delightedly.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Interesting, Your Majesty. Very in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting, Your Majesty. Very interesting."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""In any case…""
entries.dialogueText: "In any case…"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It should be evident without expla..."
entries.dialogueText: "It should be evident without explanation how crucial it is for Wehlen to support our currency."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Just look at that. It's amazing wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just look at that. It's amazing what we can accomplish when our two nations work together."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""In honor of everything we've accom..."
entries.dialogueText: "In honor of everything we've accomplished, I wanted to give you this small token of gratitude."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""A beautiful doorstopper, intricate..."
entries.dialogueText: "A beautiful doorstopper, intricately carved by our most skilled of artisans."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened his attaché case and pull..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened his attaché case and pulled out an oblong wooden object, presenting it to us with a flourish.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't help but notice the item..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't help but notice the item's unique shape.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, this truly cements our agreem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, this truly cements our agreement's place in the annals of history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am as pleased with it as I am wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am as pleased with it as I am with our negotiations as a whole."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I had a feeling you would like it,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had a feeling you would like it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm honored. It is proof that neit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm honored. It is proof that neither of us has been saddled with a bum deal."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Oh! But first...""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh! But first..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak opened a cabinet and took ou..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak opened a cabinet and took out an attaché case.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had been invited here for a long-..."
entries.dialogueText: I had been invited here for a long-overdue discussion regarding the return of Zille. However, my host was nowhere in sight.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Congratulations. I always wondered..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations. I always wondered what it would be like to have a son."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I love each of my daughters, of co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I love each of my daughters, of course. But I do feel Wiktor Jr. and I share a special bond."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""There's just one thing I'm confuse..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's just one thing I'm confused about."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Tell me, how could both he and Les..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me, how could both he and Lespia have committed the same crime?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""What an interesting approach to ju..."
entries.dialogueText: "What an interesting approach to justice you have! And the rest of your family shares that outlook, I presume."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Would you care for a drink? We've..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would you care for a drink? We've got everything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You haven't offered one to Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "You haven't offered one to President Rayne yet?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""My friend Anton is a busy man. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "My friend Anton is a busy man. But so are you, I suppose."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Our meeting three years ago didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our meeting three years ago didn't exactly fill me with confidence about Zille's security."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I was very happy with how you and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was very happy with how you and your security forces handled the Friendship Day bombing investigation."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Even if the culprit wasn't whom ei..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if the culprit wasn't whom either of us suspected."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You're handling yourselves *very*..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're handling yourselves *very* adeptly in the war on Pales. Wehlen likes winners, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The amount of military strength yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The amount of military strength you've managed to amass since your reign began is truly impressive."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Even if you're currently wasting i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if you're currently wasting it on a losing war with Pales."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It seems as if you are finally com..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems as if you are finally coming to your senses regarding your one-sided relationship with Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It troubles me that you still have..."
entries.dialogueText: "It troubles me that you still haven't come to your senses regarding your one-sided relationship with Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You caved into Supreme Lunatic Azm..."
entries.dialogueText: "You caved into Supreme Lunatic Azmal and allowed in Derdians. That was very disappointing."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Derdians remain banned from entry..."
entries.dialogueText: "Derdians remain banned from entry into your kingdom. Very nice."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I want to thank you profusely for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to thank you profusely for your country's cooperation in our Operation Bear Trap."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But that is not your fault, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that is not your fault, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your withdrawal from our Operation..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your withdrawal from our Operation Bear Trap was a betrayal of the highest order."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Bad news for your mercenaries, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bad news for your mercenaries, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me a sly grin, then looked..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me a sly grin, then looked at his cocktail napkin.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You, on the other hand.... you dar..."
entries.dialogueText: "You, on the other hand.... you dare to hire the Bluds as mercenaries? That will surely backfire on you in the end."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You promised me that Duke Ricardus..."
entries.dialogueText: "You promised me that Duke Ricardus Toras would answer for his crimes."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""When can I expect his transfer to..."
entries.dialogueText: "When can I expect his transfer to Wehlen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As soon as possible, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "As soon as possible, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's staying in Rizia. I want to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's staying in Rizia. I want to see his face when he gets the guillotine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, but I can't fulfill tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, but I can't fulfill that part of the bargain. Ricardus is a Toras. I can't let him die on foreign soil."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He contorted his face into an overe..."
entries.dialogueText: He contorted his face into an overexaggerated frown.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Not the answer I was hoping for. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not the answer I was hoping for. I hope I'm at least invited to the execution."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Excellent. Really, it's been such..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. Really, it's been such a pleasure cooperating with you."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Not to mention that you made him C..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention that you made him Chief of Police in your capital! That doesn't count as teaching him a lesson."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised his glass."
entries.dialogueText: He raised his glass.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""However, reports about environment..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, reports about environmental damage to your wine industry raise doubts about the future quality and quantity of your exports."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Proposing to shrink your share of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Proposing to shrink your share of the Meftiem International Trade Zone while production is declining at home? The future's looking far from golden."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""By the way, I have heard nothing b..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the way, I have heard nothing but gratitude from expatriates of my country living in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Not counting the new religious tax..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not counting the new religious tax, of course!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""By the way, I have heard nothing b..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the way, I have heard nothing but gratitude from expatriates of my country working in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Of course, they'd be even happier..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, they'd be even happier if you stopped subjecting their children to a forced Wruhecist education..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But I trust you have their best in..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I trust you have their best interests at heart."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""So that's it for the treaty. I mus..."
entries.dialogueText: "So that's it for the treaty. I must say, King Romus, you are a man of your word."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We had a deal. Keeping my word was..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had a deal. Keeping my word was the least I could do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Which means we can start planning..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which means we can start planning for the return of Zille. Right?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Wait, Your Majesty. The treaty is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait, Your Majesty. The treaty is not the only factor at play."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You are too modest. Of course, let..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are too modest. Of course, let's not forget the other factors at play."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It wasn't a one-sided deal. Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't a one-sided deal. Rizia benefited from it as well."

entries.dialogueText: "I promise your reservations are mistaken. I will meet any and all conditions you have for Rizia in the future."

entries.dialogueText: "I'll admit that I'm disappointed you've kept your anti-Wehzek cousin in power all this time."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
