entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""No catch. None whatsoever.""
entries.dialogueText: "No catch. None whatsoever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is truly the beginning of a b..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is truly the beginning of a beautiful friendship."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I feel the same way.""
entries.dialogueText: "I feel the same way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you really care about it that m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you really care about it that much? It's only a shack."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had brought the copy of the evide..."
entries.dialogueText: I had brought the copy of the evidence of the Zille bombing which clearly pointed to Lespia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I handed the copy to him."
entries.dialogueText: I handed the copy to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided not to share it with him,..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided not to share it with him, believing it was for the best.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""What?""
entries.dialogueText: "What?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took his time to inspect the doc..."
entries.dialogueText: He took his time to inspect the documents in detail.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Not only that, you're marrying him..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only that, you're marrying him to your daughter?! I knew you royals had crazy traditions, but that's absolutely wild."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, excuse my bluntness, but you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, excuse my bluntness, but you can go shove it up your ass, you backstabbing son of a bitch!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How kind of you. As a return gestu..."
entries.dialogueText: "How kind of you. As a return gesture, I would like to cordially invite you to my daughter Vina's wedding."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He put a hand to his heart."
entries.dialogueText: He put a hand to his heart.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Oh, Your Majesty. I would be honor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Your Majesty. I would be honored beyond words to join the Royal Family on such a special occasion."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""One of my wives and I will be ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of my wives and I will be there."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Why wouldn't one? It's the most im..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why wouldn't one? It's the most important room in the house."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Until then, consider Zille's retur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Until then, consider Zille's return on hold."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A referendum on this land is not w..."
entries.dialogueText: "A referendum on this land is not within your right to call. It's illegal, and I will challenge it in the Alliance of Nations."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Challenge accepted. We Wehzeks hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Challenge accepted. We Wehzeks have a history of resilience. I've stood against a superpower; your kingdom will be no different."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Zarptek Smolny!""
entries.dialogueText: "Zarptek Smolny!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My people would vote for their ret..."
entries.dialogueText: "My people would vote for their return. The Rizians long to come back to their homeland."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Then let the vote decide. We've be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then let the vote decide. We've been granted this fair process by Arcasian revolutionaries of old, and I intend to use it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're a world leader, President S..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a world leader, President Smolak. I implore you to let go of this petty fixation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That house holds great sentimental..."
entries.dialogueText: "That house holds great sentimental value to my mother. She'd never forgive me if she lost it."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Petty? Me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Petty? Me?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And you know how much I hate doubt..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you know how much I hate doubt, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Having said that... I'm afraid I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that... I'm afraid I'm going to need just a little bit more from you in order to reach the level of trust I desire from an ally."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused, eyes widening as an idea..."
entries.dialogueText: He paused, eyes widening as an idea struck.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Actually...""
entries.dialogueText: "Actually..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused, eyes widening as if stru..."
entries.dialogueText: He paused, eyes widening as if struck with an idea.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Actually...""
entries.dialogueText: "Actually..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your refusal to find common ground..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your refusal to find common ground on anything is disheartening. It makes me wonder whether Zille even wants you as its ruler."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""In that case...""
entries.dialogueText: "In that case..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I thought as much. Your antiquated..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought as much. Your antiquated monarchy has no respect for the democratic process."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If that's the way it's going to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's the way it's going to be..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may have toyed with Rizia in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may have toyed with Rizia in the past, but we now command one of the strongest armies on the Merkopan continent. It would be extremely unwise to anger us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak was silent for a long time...."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak was silent for a long time. Finally, he burst out laughing.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I was kidding, Your Majesty! A har..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was kidding, Your Majesty! A harmless joke between friends."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Zille is all yours. No strings att..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille is all yours. No strings attached."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Plush magenta seats lined the cabin..."
entries.dialogueText: Plush magenta seats lined the cabin, each embellished with opulent tassels and cushions embroidered with the Wehlen crest.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""After eleven daughters, courtesy o..."
entries.dialogueText: "After eleven daughters, courtesy of my eight wives -- all of whom I’m still married to -- I finally have a boy! Meet Wiktor Smolak II.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""They'll be time for all of that so..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll be time for all of that soon enough."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We've got a long flight ahead of u..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've got a long flight ahead of us, which will give us plenty of time to talk."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your Golden Guard arrested Duke Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Golden Guard arrested Duke Ricardus Toras for his involvement in the bombing."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Especially if you've done somethin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially if you've done something wrong."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Ah, that's right. We never came to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, that's right. We never came to an agreement over ZiIle."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It was as if Rizia didn't respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was as if Rizia didn't respect Wehlen or her wishes at all."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You've really taken it upon yourse..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've really taken it upon yourself to better their situation."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But hey, if you're so eager to paw..."
entries.dialogueText: "But hey, if you're so eager to pawn off your family history, who am I to refuse?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You seem to forget rule number one..."
entries.dialogueText: "You seem to forget rule number one in the art of diplomatic bargaining..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It's a win-win for both of us, rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a win-win for both of us, really."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Nor should it. Having gold as Wehl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nor should it. Having gold as Wehlen's backup currency naturally adds to our financial stability."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And the last thing I'd want is for..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the last thing I'd want is for people to think I can be taken advantage of."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Some of our compatriots still have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some of our compatriots still have respect for the democratic process, you see."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I was considering offering to hold..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was considering offering to hold a referendum in Zille, letting the people choose between staying in Wehlen or returning to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""In that case, I'm afraid that I ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "In that case, I'm afraid that I have no choice but to hold a referendum in Zille regarding the issue of reunification."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Give me a break... In any case...""
entries.dialogueText: "Give me a break... In any case..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Enough for me to consider opening..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough for me to consider opening the door for a referendum in Zille."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""His diaper's due for a change, whi..."
entries.dialogueText: "His diaper's due for a change, which I'm sure will smell better than the bull excrement in this room."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We cannot afford for it to resurfa..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot afford for it to resurface."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It's not just about him. It's abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not just about him. It's about the message his arrest would send to others who seek to upend social norms."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I believe the decision of reunific..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe the decision of reunification should be up to the people of Zille to decide."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The way I see it, it should be up..."
entries.dialogueText: "The way I see it, it should be up to the people of Zille to decide.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Having a choice in the matter is c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having a choice in the matter is crucial."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Let's embrace it as an opportunity..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's embrace it as an opportunity for progress and mutual understanding."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'll take my leave so that you may..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll take my leave so that you may reflect upon the implications of your decisions."

entries.dialogueText: "There's an urgent piece of information I need to share with you before we begin. I have it on good authority that Lespia plotted the Friendship Day bombing."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Lespia?""
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He narrowed his eyes suspiciously."
entries.dialogueText: He narrowed his eyes suspiciously.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you have to bring a baby here?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you have to bring a baby here? We've got real work to do."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I bring him everywhere, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I bring him everywhere, Your Majesty! No assassin would dare put a bullet through this adorable face."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor II squealed as his father ho..."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor II squealed as his father hoisted him proudly in the air.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I slept wonderfully. Now, shall we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I slept wonderfully. Now, shall we get down to business?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We've waited three years for this..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've waited three years for this moment. What's another five minutes?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll sleep better once I know that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll sleep better once I know that Zille is safely back in Rizian hands."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Don't you trust Wehlen? We've been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you trust Wehlen? We've been keeping the region safe and sound for you."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""What an awfully convenient time fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "What an awfully convenient time for such a shocking revelation to emerge. I don't suppose you have evidence?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will very soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will very soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do, but it's too sensitive to sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do, but it's too sensitive to share on a blimp."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're going to have to trust me o..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're going to have to trust me on this."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""'Soon' isn't soon enough, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Soon' isn't soon enough, Your Majesty. I've had this meeting in my diary for three years now. I'm not going to postpone it."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""A blimp? This is an airship! And i..."
entries.dialogueText: "A blimp? This is an airship! And it's the most secure environment there is."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If you can't provide us with concr..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you can't provide us with concrete proof, these accusations mean nothing."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Come on, Your Majesty. There are l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Your Majesty. There are limits to even our friendship."
